What Tapestry is

Tapestry is a personal tool for organizing Bible verses into collections and listening to them read aloud. Scripture text is drawn from public-domain translations. Topic and keyword search draw on public-domain reference works. "Describe it" search uses AI to suggest possible verse references only — it never generates or alters scripture text.

Accounts
